applies_to: Swegon COMPACT and GOLD LP air handling units with controller program version 2.01 or later.
summary: Swegon's Compact and GOLD LP air handlers have a built-in BACnet IP interface (B-ASC profile) on the unit controller. The list has 600 objects of four types: analog inputs for airflows, pressures, temperatures and operating modes, analog values for setpoints, regulator tuning, clock and time/year channels, plus binary inputs and values for outputs, alarms and functions. Several numbered 'Reserve' objects are placeholders.
notes: Only AI, AV, BI and BV objects are used; modes and selections are AVs with numbered states.
Instances are not contiguous and 'Reserve' objects carry no data.
Units are taken from the Min/Max column (l/s, Pa, °C, %, s, min); unitless ranges are left blank.
Operating state is reported as codes in AI-84 Operation mode 1 and AI-85 Operation mode 2.

source.title: BACnet IP Compact/GOLD LP, program version 2.01 and newer versions

integration.summary: Write AV-174 Communication operation mode to run the unit from the BMS (0 hands control back to the unit's own time channels) and read AI-84 Operation mode 1 to see why it is running or stopped. Map supply and extract air temperature, the EA/room setpoint and the low/high speed airflow or pressure setpoints, plus BI-5/BI-6 A/B alarms and BV-0 alarm reset. These are the objects the source's overview page highlights.

minimum_points.name: Communication operation mode
minimum_points.why: BMS stop / low / high / auto command

minimum_points.name: Outdoor temperatur
minimum_points.why: Outdoor air temp measured by the unit, °C

integration.enable: AV-174 Communication operation mode: 0=Auto operation, 1=Communication stop 1, 2=Communication low speed, 3=Communication high speed, 4=Communication stop 2. Summer night cool, intermittent night heat and morning boost still run at stop 2.
integration.heartbeat: Only for BMS-supplied temperatures: AV-204 'Timeout temperature com.' (0-9999 min) sets the timeout for room and outdoor temperatures written over communication. The document does not describe a timeout for the operation mode command.
integration.remote_sensors: Set AV-200 EA/Room temperature (external) func. to 2 (Communication) and write AV-201; set AV-202 Outdoor temperature (external) func. to 2 and write AV-203. AV-204 is the timeout for those written values.
setup: BACnet IP only; the device is a B-ASC supporting read/write property, COV and dynamic device/object binding.
Swegon refers to a separate BACnet PICS and EDE file; device instance and IP settings are not in this document.
gotchas: Setpoints exist separately for low and high speed (e.g. AV-0/1 SA airflow, AV-8/9 SA duct pressure).
Fan regulation mode (AV-97 SA, EA equivalent) decides whether airflow, pressure or demand setpoints are used.
Clock, time-channel and year-channel AVs (around 120-290) are configuration settings.
Reserve objects return no meaningful data.
